commits.subject: Blueprint: representability of the rank strata (Nitsure §4, n=0). New section with 22 nodes matching FlatteningStratificationUniversal.lean 1-to-1: pullback of matrix presentations to section modules, flat-sections/flat-sheaf bridges, the rank dictionary (stalk rank = point rank, point rank of a pullback), the kernel bound I_e ≤ ker(q) and unique factorization through the stratum, flatness of the stratum pullback, the chart locus W_e with Nakayama chart supply, the rank stratum S_e ⊆ W_e as locally closed subscheme with support the rank-e locus, boundedness and openness of rank fibers, and unique factorization through S_e. Rewrote the proof of thm:flattening_stratification_universal to the completed Lean argument (disjoint open rank pieces of T, piecewise unique lifts, assembly and uniqueness through the coproduct) and marked it \leanok.
